text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 409 March 11, 1974
PROVIDING INCENTIVES FOR GOVERNMENT TECHNICIANS ASSISTING IN THE
IMPLEMENTATION OF SUPERVISED CREDIT PROGRAMS OF THE GOVERNMENT
WHEREAS, it is the primary concern of the Government to promote and stimulate increased agricultural
production in order to attain food self-sufficiency;
WHEREAS, in pursuance of this objective, the Government undertakes special supervised credit programs
designed to improve the productive capacity of farmers by providing them the necessary financial and
technical assistance without the need for real-estate collateral;
WHEREAS, banks and financial institutions play a vital role in the implementation of the special financing
program of the Government for agricultural production with the technical assistance and support of the
various government agencies and instrumentalities;
WHEREAS, in order to maximize the participation of government technicians in the effective and efficient
implementation of the supervised credit programs of the government, it is necessary that they be provided
with enough motivation and encouragement in the form of incentive bonuses, allowances and other
appropriate forms of remunerations;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081 dated September 21, 1972 and General Order No. 1 dated September 22,
1972, as amended, do hereby decree and order that, the provisions of any law, decree, rule, regulation or order
to the contrary notwithstanding, government technicians assigned to banks and financial institutions for the
purpose of providing technical assistance and support in carrying out the supervised credit programs of the
Government for agricultural production are hereby authorized to receive incentive allowances, bonuses and
other appropriate forms of remuneration from said banks and financial institutions and/or from the
Government, subject to the rules and regulations to be issued jointly by the Department of Agriculture and
Natural Resources and the Central Bank of the Philippines.
This Decree shall take effect immediately and shall have retroactive effect to cover payments of incentive
allowances and bonuses due the government technicians who participated in the Masagana 99 Rice Program
and all other special financing programs of the Government.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
